def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    import re
    # Try to read from structured inputs first
    s = inputs.get('s')
    mult = inputs.get('mult') or inputs.get('multiplier') or inputs.get('a')
    add = inputs.get('add') or inputs.get('increment') or inputs.get('c')
    mod = inputs.get('mod') or inputs.get('modulus') or inputs.get('m')
    n = inputs.get('n') or inputs.get('times') or inputs.get('repeat')
    if s is None or mult is None or add is None or mod is None or n is None:
        text = inputs.get('text') or inputs.get('problem') or ''
        if not text:
            for v in inputs.values():
                if isinstance(v, str):
                    text = v
                    break
        nums = list(map(int, re.findall(r'-?\d+', text)))
        # pattern: Initialize s = A. Repeat N times: s = (M*s + K) % P
        # numbers: [A, M, K, P, N]  (skip leading problem index if present)
        # heuristic: find "Initialize s = X"
        m0 = re.search(r'=\s*(-?\d+)', text)
        s = int(m0.group(1))
        mm = re.search(r'(\d+)\s*\*\s*s\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*%\s*(\d+)', text)
        mult = int(mm.group(1)); add = int(mm.group(2)); mod = int(mm.group(3))
        nn = re.search(r'(\d+)\s*times', text)
        n = int(nn.group(1))
    s = int(s); mult = int(mult); add = int(add); mod = int(mod); n = int(n)
    for _ in range(n):
        s = (mult * s + add) % mod
    return float(s)

def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    import re
    text = inputs.get('text') or inputs.get('problem') or ''
    if not text:
        for v in inputs.values():
            if isinstance(v, str):
                text = v
                break
    X = inputs.get('X') or inputs.get('x')
    n = inputs.get('n') or inputs.get('times') or inputs.get('repeat')
    a = inputs.get('a'); b = inputs.get('b'); c = inputs.get('c')
    if X is None or n is None or a is None or b is None or c is None:
        mx = re.search(r'X\s*=\s*(\d+)', text)
        X = int(mx.group(1))
        nn = re.search(r'Repeat\s+(\d+)\s+times', text)
        n = int(nn.group(1))
        # shift amounts in order: << , >> , <<
        shifts = re.findall(r'(<<|>>)\s*(\d+)', text)
        a = int(shifts[0][1]); b = int(shifts[1][1]); c = int(shifts[2][1])
    X = int(X); n = int(n); a = int(a); b = int(b); c = int(c)
    mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
    for _ in range(n):
        X ^= (X << a) & mask
        X &= mask
        X ^= (X >> b)
        X &= mask
        X ^= (X << c) & mask
        X &= mask
    return float(X)
